## Summary

Describe what changed, why it belongs in nx-toolbox, and whether it adds a new tool or changes an existing one.

## Verification

- [ ] Python sources compile successfully.
- [ ] Destructive file operations have a preview or explicit confirmation.
- [ ] The launcher remains independent from any single tool module.
- [ ] `version.json`, runtime version constants, and release notes are synchronized when applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, console keys, personal saves, private notes, local paths, or build output were added.
- [ ] English and Simplified Chinese documentation were updated where required.

## Third-party material

List every new external source, exact version, and license. Write `None` when this pull request adds no third-party material.
